reasons: STRUCTURAL GAP: a participant-directed 404(c) menu assumes daily pricing and daily participant liquidity, whereas this wrapper deals 4x/year. Direct DIA use requires a bridging structure: CIT sleeve, managed account, or TDF sleeve (cell 3.5).

Capacity: 4x per year at 5.0% of outstanding shares (fundamental 5-25% policy, though the Fund states it expects only the 5% minimum, with an optional +2% then pro rata). This is a FUND-level cap, and at a 5% plan allocation the plan's position is far inside it unless offers are oversubscribed.
Scenario demand (illustrative): 9.2% of the position per year vs 20% annual wrapper capacity. Adequate headroom at this allocation if offers are not prorated.

Cadence reliability evidence: all four FY2025 offers at 5.00% and undersubscribed (2.09-2.88% actually repurchased, $480.0M total). MRPS 225% asset-coverage trigger can cap repurchases at 5% (3.3/3.6).
Early repurchase economics: none ('The Fund will not charge a repurchase fee'), with a 1.00% CDSC on Class C < 365 days only (2.7). Relevant to participant-level churn (2.7).
